definitions.explanation: A break or pause in the middle of an activity, event, or period. Can refer to a literal rest period or a temporary lull in something ongoing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中休|なかやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I had coffee during the mid-morning break.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中休|なかやす}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{晴|は}れた→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧。
examples.english: There was a break in the rainy season and it was sunny for the first time in a while.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{十分間|じゅっぷんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中休|なかやす}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: We took a ten-minute break in the middle of the long meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used for weather patterns — ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中休|なかやす}み (a break in the rainy season) and ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中休|なかやす}み (a break from the intense heat) are very common expressions in weather forecasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中休|なかやす}み (break in the rainy season)
- {中休|なかやす}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a mid-break)
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中休|なかやす}み (respite from extreme heat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧: break, rest (more general and formal)
- ⟦{一息|ひといき}→一息：07781_hitoiki⟧: a breather (shorter, more casual)
